senses.gloss: pr. n. m. (abbr. of אֲחִיָּה) Ḥiyya, name of several Amoraim. Esp. R. Ḥ. Robah (the elder, רובה, רבא, רבה), the redactor of the Tosefta in conjunction with R. Oshaya.
